name: Dialog
description: A modal window for a focused task or a confirmation. Traps focus, locks scroll and hides the page behind it from assistive technology; Escape, the close button and the backdrop close it, and focus returns to the trigger. Replaces Modal.

livewire.name: dialog
capabilities: wire:model binds open both ways through $wire.entangle()

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it's open. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model:open. Emitted as data-state on every part.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled dialog.

props.name: size
props.description: The panel's width: 360px, --apui-dialog-width (480px) or 640px, never wider than the viewport. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: role
props.description: alertdialog for confirmations that interrupt: the backdrop doesn't close it, and focus starts on the close button, the safe action.

props.name: surface
props.description: The panel's surface. Emitted as data-surface. Glass falls back to the overlay surface under reduced transparency and in high contrast.

props.name: color
props.description: Tints the header icon, for confirmations. Emitted as data-color.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon name from the registry, shown in a tinted circle before the title. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, linked to the panel with aria-labelledby.
props.a11y: Every dialog needs a title; it is the panel's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the title, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: footer
props.description: The actions row. Name the confirm action ("Delete listing"), not "OK".

props.name: trigger
props.description: Content for a trigger button that opens the dialog. Without it, open the dialog through open.

props.name: modal
props.description: Traps focus, locks scroll and hides the rest of the page from assistive technology. Turn it off only for a dialog that must leave the page usable.

props.name: portal
props.description: Renders the dialog at the end of the body, above everything (x-teleport, a React portal, Vue Teleport). Off renders it in place.

props.name: hideClose
props.description: Hides the close button in the header. Escape still closes the dialog.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The close button's accessible name. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Close' ).
props.a11y: The close button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { header: '…', body: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The panel, carrying the root class. It is Zag's content part, so it also carries data-part="content" (D-019).

parts.name: content
parts.description: The panel: the same element as root.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: The button that opens the dialog, when trigger is set.

parts.name: positioner
parts.description: Fills the viewport and centers the panel.

parts.name: header
parts.description: Icon, title, description and close button.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: The tinted icon before the title.

parts.name: closeTrigger
parts.description: The close button: a ghost, neutral, small icon-only Button.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Rich title content, rendered inside the heading.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The dialog opened or closed itself: the trigger, Escape, the backdrop or the close button. Setting open doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: Move between the controls inside; focus stays in the dialog.
Closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger.
On the trigger, opens the dialog.

requirements: Focus moves into the dialog on open and is trapped there while it's modal; it returns to the trigger on close.
The title is linked with aria-labelledby and the description with aria-describedby.
A modal dialog sets aria-modal and hides everything else from assistive technology, and locks page scroll.
Destructive confirmations use alertdialog: the backdrop doesn't close them and focus starts on the safe action.
The close button has an accessible name (translatable, "Close").
Text keeps 4.5:1 and the panel's edge 3:1 on the overlay surface in every theme, glass included.
Glass falls back to the overlay surface under prefers-reduced-transparency, without backdrop-filter, and in high contrast.
Every part keeps a stable, server-rendered id in Livewire, so morphs never replace the panel (D-015).
